attribution.name: 邵建和、邵建初
attribution.note: Brothers from the Tang court workshop that cut imperial jade tablets.
attribution.noteZh: 兄弟二人为唐中书省玉册官，专办御用刻石。

background: A Tang stele of 841, composed by Pei Xiu and written and titled in seal script by Liu Gongquan, held at the Xi’an Beilin Museum.
